title: Review every PR with the trusted base reviewer
body: Outcome: every krn review runs the trusted base reviewer, not the code under review. Evidence: PR #174 review ran from the main checkout bin/krn with absolute --lens/--checklist into the PR worktree (record toolSha 63e9390 = base, PASS in one attempt, .krn/runs/delivery-loop/deliver-traps/review-enum-1.json); krn-lead step 7 still runs head bin/krn from the PR worktree for other PRs, so head code writes its own review record. Acceptance: krn-lead step 7 names one review invocation from the main checkout for every PR, and preflight or review refuses (or flags) a record whose toolSha is not an ancestor of the PR base, with an observer red at base by assertion.
